intro: This quest represents the proof of felling Ursangous, one of the most ferocious and legendary predators prowling Ashenvale. Bringing the beast's severed paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post earns honor among the Horde's trackers and reveals a subtle connection between the great bear and the local night elves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt. On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.
The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah - friend - I was just thinking about you! How goes your hunting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the paw of Ursangous! Your skill is impressive, adventurer; he is credited with numerous kills. The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale. Ursangous is... Was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.
